metadata.title: Civ13 weapon attachments: scope removal, optic rail and red dot (PR #3081)
metadata.description: Native Dream Seeker footage of Civ13 PR #3081 at merged game commit 60b8cf9937617d62c4cc01f82bf32401559b84f4, BYOND 516.1681. An unloaded SVD has its PSO-1 scope removed with a screwdriver, then receives a dovetail-to-Picatinny rail and red dot sight. Native Examine shows the changed attachment. This is a disposable local equipment scene, not a multiplayer round or production-server recording. Conventional cuts, captions, focus enlargement and highlights; retained actions play at 1x; no audio. The 60 percent condition assignment is artificial test setup, not a repair. Completed cleaning, bench repair and firing are not demonstrated. Startup logged Bad ref/DecRefCount and nslookup diagnostics, so this is not clean full-game runtime acceptance. Source and limitations: https://github.com/Civ13/Civ13/pull/3081#issuecomment-6115344644

Game HUD, test messages and fictional gun serial remain; no private chat, credentials, session Game ID, real player identity or internal paths observed.
